snippet.title: Blue Sun Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
This is a first look of my brand new game Blue Sun.

Wishlist Blue Sun on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5102930/Blue_Sun/

After years of oppression, the time has come to rise up. In this narrative boss-rush game, uncover the conflict's history and take down FOFEC, an experimental enemy unit stripped of its humanity and modified to become the perfect super soldiers.
